_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 08: 2024-02-01 to 2024-08-01. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He relays that the Lord told him they are coming into the last half of the year, framed against the devil coming to kill and destroy while God gives abundant life.
mentions.quote: Brandon you're coming to the last half of
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him to have people believe bigger in 2024 for exceedingly abundantly above what they ask, and he says he saw again a supernatural harvest of the wealth of the sinner.
mentions.quote: I saw a supernatural Harvest of of the weal
mentions.falsify_match: A visible transfer of wealth to the church in late 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He describes interceding on the 4th of July and praying in what sounded to him like an Asian tongue, unlike anything he had prayed before, which gripped him.
mentions.quote: I went into a Asian tongue I don't know it was sounded
mentions.falsify_match: A revival across Asia following this.

mentions.claim_text: He says events will come one after another and pick up speed, comparing it to a story that has died off in the news, because the Lord said he is going to draw the people in.
mentions.quote: events boop boop boop boop boop and it's going to going to pick up speed
mentions.falsify_match: A visibly accelerating run of events drawing people to faith in Asia.

mentions.claim_text: Defending another prophet against the charge of being false because a word did not land in its stated time frame, he says God's timing is perfect and tells viewers to go back and listen again.
mentions.quote: if it doesn't happen within that time frame, every like, Oh, he's a false prophet
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a general defence of missed timing, applied to someone else and to himself.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing a woman with sandy blonde hair whose face the Lord blotted out so he could not see it, and saw them hit her while she was beside Kamala Harris, running up into January.
mentions.quote: hit her going beside Camila Harris going clear up into uh the January
mentions.falsify_match: A blonde woman alongside Harris coming under attack before January 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he warned in September 2023 that the sitting president would not even be running, that it would not happen, and that he had thought it was coming in November 2023, so he was seeing ahead but misjudged when.
mentions.quote: be even running. It will not happen. And I told you this last year 2023
mentions.falsify_match: A September 2023 statement in the corpus that Biden would not run, which the 2024 withdrawal would then match.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement is found at that date.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told his son there would be an October surprise and that they did get one, for Israel rather than America, which he takes as what the Lord had been showing him about a serious event.
mentions.quote: we did have an October surprise for Israel
mentions.falsify_match: The 7 October 2023 attack matches a prior warning of a serious October event, though he says he had expected it in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: No prior October warning exists in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer taking authority over plagues, pestilence and terrorist activity, pleading the blood over the Olympics so that no weapon formed against those there prospers.
mentions.quote: We plead the blood of Jesus over the Olympics
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
mentions.falsify_miss: The games pass without one, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that hidden things be revealed, that there will be a godly person in the White House in 2024, and that starting 2025 there will not be a financial crisis.
mentions.quote: there will be a godly person in the White House in 2024
mentions.falsify_match: No financial crisis at the start of 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: A crisis arrives, against this declaration and for his crash claims.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that praying in tongues gives a language the devil cannot understand, unlike praying in English where he hears you complaining about the flesh.
mentions.quote: the devil doesn't understand what you're saying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that feeding your spirit daily as you feed your flesh makes you strong in the spirit realm, whereas feeding it once a week on Sunday does not.
mentions.quote: if you only feed your spirit one day a week on Sunday
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He dates the encounter to 6 July 2014, says he does not know whether he was in or out of the body, and that when shown the Antichrist he saw the facial features and the clothes but not the eyes.
mentions.quote: whenever the Lord showed me the Antichrist I did not see his eyes
mentions.falsify_match: An identified figure matching the described features and dress.
mentions.falsify_miss: No identification is ever made, and the description is withheld.

mentions.claim_text: Speculating about the Antichrist's private life, he allows that a man could be married without his wife knowing who he really is, and concedes he may have it wrong.
mentions.quote: I may have
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: openly marked as speculation.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is a very serious time that will be life and death, that they are not to fear, and passes on an instruction to get a hundred pounds off as quickly as possible.
mentions.quote: you get 100 lb off right now you do it as quickly as possible
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as a claim about the world; recorded as a preparedness instruction with a stated reason.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are being delivered and set free, that the devil is a defeated foe, and that the Lord called him to tell people Jesus is coming.
mentions.quote: the Lord's called me to tell people that Jesus is coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a commission.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the plague vision: a pestilence waist high and airborne, seen at the base of everything, followed by a complete shutdown of society beyond what has been seen.
mentions.quote: it was waste high that it was coming out of it was airborne
mentions.falsify_match: An airborne pandemic causing a shutdown deeper than 2020.

mentions.claim_text: In the same vision he sees megachurches completely shut down and a melting of the financial structure beyond comprehension, far worse than 2020, with people passing away.
mentions.quote: mega churches completely shut down a complete melt melting of a a financial structure
mentions.falsify_match: Megachurch closures and financial collapse arriving together with the plague.

mentions.claim_text: He says the lifting of the hand is where this sits, that where sin abounds grace abounds more but the wages of sin is still death, and that God is holy.
mentions.quote: the lifting of the hand
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a theological reading of why the plague comes.

mentions.claim_text: He says the black horse rider comes later but that the economy of America is about to crash, and that he believes it is in 2025 because he has seen it and an angel came to him.
mentions.quote: I believe in 2025, I've seen it. The angel came to me
mentions.falsify_match: A crash of the American economy during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Answering that he has only been online less than a year, he says the things he sees come to pass, to give it time, and that he is that confident.
mentions.quote: the things I see come to pass. Give it time. You'll see it
mentions.falsify_match: His record, taken as a whole, shows dated claims landing above the base rate.

mentions.claim_text: He says a storm is coming that is a wake up, a shaking to awaken, that it will be financial among other things, and refers back to what he has already said about the black horse.
mentions.quote: coming but it is a wake up a wake up it's a shaken to awaken
mentions.falsify_match: A financial crisis widely read as a wake up call.

mentions.claim_text: He revisits what he calls one of the most serious visions he has ever had, given nine months earlier, saying at the time it seemed too far out to see how it could happen, and is unsure whether it was a dream or a vision.
mentions.quote: this was one of the most serious Visions I'd had
mentions.falsify_match: The underlying event arrives; the passage itself only dates the origin.

mentions.claim_text: He says anyone who spends time daily with the Father will be spoken to and told secret things, that God is no respecter of persons, and that people may be jealous or critical about it.
mentions.quote: he will tell you secret things he will come and visit you
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on daily time with God
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Discussing another prophet whose economic storm was expected on 8 April, he says that if it does not happen he will not throw stones because he believes she heard the Lord and saw something, and calls for grace rather than beating people up.
mentions.quote: economic storm doesn't happen on April 8th well I'm not throwing stones at her
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a rule for handling other people's misses that keeps the seer credible either way.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether anything will happen on 8 April with the eclipse, he says plainly that he does not believe so, that he has not seen anything for that date, and that this is his own position when he prays.
mentions.quote: in my spirit personally I've not seen anything on April the 8th
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing of consequence happened on 8 April 2024, which matches this.
mentions.falsify_miss: A major event on that date would have counted against him.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing people protesting with signs demanding their entitlements, welfare and food stamps because all government funded welfare programmes had been cut off, with lines of people ten thousand deep.
mentions.quote: all of the government funded welfare programs were gone
mentions.falsify_match: Federal welfare and food assistance cut off, followed by mass protest.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to ring the bells to wake the people, shown as church bells over a dark and sleeping church with dark windows, and repeats that Jesus is coming.
mentions.quote: ring the bells he did say that ring the bells ring them up
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image of a sleeping church.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are reading the eclipse as a sign over Nineveh but that God is doing it on purpose to get attention because he loves us, and that it is not about politics or who becomes president.
mentions.quote: it's because it's on purpose God's trying to get people's attention
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an interpretation of purpose behind an event.

mentions.claim_text: He says demonstrations of glory could begin this summer, and that if they start around May, June or July they could be out of here by October, describing a six month window.
mentions.quote: we could be out of here by October
mentions.falsify_match: The rapture occurring by October 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: It did not, though he frames it as could rather than will.

mentions.claim_text: He describes believers in white suits with the glory on them touching people who are healed, says he is always looking for Christ to come quickly, and allows they may have a couple of years or five or six years left.
mentions.quote: we may have a couple years left we may have five six years left
mentions.falsify_match: The return occurring inside that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, though the range is wide enough to be near-unscoreable.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being fourteen pounds down and says an app projects he will reach his target weight by October if he maintains the calorie target daily.
mentions.quote: all of my weight off before October
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on maintaining the daily calorie target
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level: a personal weight goal, though it dates the instruction he later attributes to the Lord.

mentions.claim_text: He says believers have authority to intercede so that a thousand may fall at their side and it not touch them, and prays against any plan to destroy America, referring back to a vision he has described before.
mentions.quote: any plan they have to to to try to destroy America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a thwarted plan and no plan look the same.
